# Pluto Theory

> Marketing in a click. Pluto Theory builds AI marketing automations and offers them through subscriptions. About 70% of the business is automation; the other 30% is a studio for brand, shoots, PR outreach and bespoke builds.

## Automations (all in early access)
- [SEO automation](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/seo): Keep site checks, improvement work and SEO reporting moving.
- [Lead generation](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/lead-generation): Capture and organise supported enquiries, then connect them to a clear next step.
- [CRM & follow-up](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/crm): Keep records, owners and follow-ups connected.
- [LinkedIn content](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/linkedin): Turn your expertise into a repeatable content process.
- [Instagram content](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/instagram): Bring assets, captions, reviews and scheduling together.
- [Performance marketing](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/performance-marketing): Bring campaign information, checks and next actions together.
- [PR workflow](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/pr): Find opportunities, prepare angles and track next steps.
- [Websites & landing pages](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/websites): Create and maintain useful pages, then connect their enquiries to the next step.
